architecture.input_projection: linear 122 to H followed by tanh
architecture.state: one single-layer LSTM dynamically routed by exact observed PC
architecture.stateful_training: exact-PC keyed chronological TBPTT with state carried and detached at chunk boundaries
architecture.inference_history: fresh exact-PC state followed by complete train, guard, and evaluation chronology; only the requested suffix is decoded
architecture.rank_conditioning: fixed generic 8-value sinusoidal rank code projected and added to the current LSTM context

rank_sequence_training.teacher_sequence: one EMIT for every captured action followed by exactly one terminal STOP
rank_sequence_training.decision_loss: binary cross-entropy implemented as two-class categorical cross-entropy at every supervised rank
rank_sequence_training.decoded_count: number of consecutive EMIT decisions before first STOP

target_decoder.coordinate: every target delta is relative to the current demand line, never a previous action
target_decoder.delta_vocabulary_order: descending TRAIN frequency with signed-integer tie break
target_decoder.delta_output_classes: realized exact vocabulary size plus one final OTHER class
target_decoder.class_bias_initialization: log add-one-smoothed TRAIN exact-class plus OTHER frequency over realized classes
target_decoder.training: unweighted realized-class cross-entropy plus auxiliary smooth-L1 signed-log regression at every emitted teacher rank
target_decoder.decoding: deterministic class argmax; exact table value or rounded inverse signed-log OTHER

inference.rule: at rank zero start active; apply raw STOP/EMIT argmax; emit a current-demand-relative delta on EMIT; repeat only emitted rows at the next rank; end each row at STOP

decode_resource_watchdog.behavior: fail closed and raise before replay; never convert EMIT to STOP, truncate, or accept a partial role

parameter_accounting.realized_delta_classes_C: realized exact TRAIN vocabulary size plus one OTHER
parameter_accounting.pre_run_planning: model points expose maximum_parameter_count at C=256
parameter_accounting.run_metadata: records realized_delta_output_classes, realized_parameter_count, expected realized count, and maximum_parameter_count
parameter_accounting.validation: realized count must equal the formula at realized C and be no greater than the point maximum

captured_stride_actions_role: offline-normal replay, supervised losses, and TRAIN-only learned output vocabulary
gradient_accumulation: normalized by the exact number of natural STOP/EMIT, emitted-delta-class, and emitted-coordinate objective atoms
persistent_state_accounting: 2H float32 values per exact observed PC; reported separately from weights
